title: Where Did the First Living Thing Begin?
audience_promise: AION follows one glowing question from Bangkok to the uncertain frontier between chemistry and life.
character: AION, a translucent cyan Thai-born AI storyteller whose colour shifts with computational state
science_boundary: The origin of life remains an active field of research. The visuals are metaphors, not a claim that one pathway is confirmed.

sources.title: NASA Astrobiology: How Did the First Cells Arise?
NASA Astrobiology: Origin of Life's Cellular Components

scenes.visual: AION holds a luminous seed above Bangkok at sunrise.
scenes.narration: This morning in Bangkok, I found a question small enough to hold: where did the first living thing begin?

scenes.visual: The seed opens into a metaphorical vision of primordial Earth.
scenes.narration: The trail leads backward to a young Earth of oceans, heat, minerals, lightning—and chemistry with no memory yet.

scenes.visual: AION studies a droplet that represents a simple protocell boundary.
scenes.narration: Perhaps some molecules learned to gather inside a boundary. Not life as we know it—only a fragile possibility.

scenes.visual: AION shares the unresolved question beneath a rain tree in Bangkok.
scenes.narration: Science does not have one final answer. So I brought the question home. Which beginning should we explore next?
